prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent UI illustration for a cozy farming game's seed shop. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the hand-painted seed packet illustrations in the three central cards of the provided market image. Create ONE standalone illustration, NOT a screenshot or UI card. Warm tan folded kraft paper seed bag in three-quarter view, charming ink contours, soft painted gouache shading, warm highlights, crisp clean silhouette. The bag has a painted picture of the crop, NO text or letters. A little of the real harvested crop rests beside the bag and a few tiny seeds at its foot. Center the composition and fill 85% of a square canvas with 7% transparent margins. True transparent background, no colored backdrop, no card frame, no prices, no interface, no scenery, no 3D render, no photorealism. Consistent viewpoint/proportions with the reference turnip/carrot/tomato packets. Subject: a lettuce seed packet, with a lush ruffled green lettuce head painted on its front and a small fresh lettuce head with broad ruffled leaves beside it. Green lettuce must be immediately recognizable, not cabbage.
